text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sigh… This test covers too much. I was hoping to focus on training for my races too, but at this rate…
choice_data_list: Juggling classes and races must be tough.
Juggling classes and races must be tough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hmph. As if you'd know. Your workload decreases whenever I have to study for tests.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No kidding. I thought I knew what I was getting myself into when I came to Tracen, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Maybe I should give up on training too hard during exam season…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Maybe I should give up on training too hard during exam season…
Stop right there, you prickly pear!
Stop right there, you cool cactus!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That's a big no-no! Are you trying to sap the color from your world by your own hand?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You're gonna let society get you down and give up on what you wanna do? Take a big ol' bite outta that kinda mentality!

text_block_list.name: Pearl and Windy
text_block_list.text: We are Worldwide Windy! We're the whirlwind that bites the world!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Do whatever you wanna do! Who cares about stuff like tests?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You're too naive, Windy! A true racer of the world needs to be greedy enough to achieve both!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Uh, sure, but I don't have that kind of time…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Well, that's an easy fix. ♪ If you can't make more time, then just train more in the time you do have!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Don't confine yourself to rigid, formulaic training! Practice more efficiently and boldly!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: In other words, you must do special training!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Special training? For what?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Your trainer here will lay it all out for you! ♪ Well? What is it Dober needs to catch up with the world?
choice_data_list: Th-the determination to keep chasing her dreams!
The power to overcome her nerves, I guess?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Your trainer here will lay it all out for you! ♪ Well? What is it Dober needs to catch up with the world?
choice_data_list: Th-the determination to keep chasing her dreams!
The power to overcome her nerves, I guess?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Determination…

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Determination's real important! I have the determination to keep pullin' pranks on people no matter how mad they get at me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I've got it, Dober! If you want to improve your determination…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hiking is the answer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: A corner of the world we live in… In other words, the outside world!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: By hiking, you don't mean that giant mountain in the distance, do you?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I certainly do. ♪ If you seek the summit in life, then you must first reach the summit of a mountain!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wh-what?! Is that really how it works?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… This is so hard…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: No complaining, girl! We're aiming for the summit, aka your dream of reaching stardom in the racing world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Can you make it?! Surely you can get to the new world without stopping!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I-I know all that, but must I do it while pulling my trainer on a sled?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: The extra weight isn't bothering me, but it's so difficult to keep my balance while walking…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I don't need your encouragement!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I know!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You made it! You've reached the summit! This is a special stage only those with true determination can reach!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You made it! You've reached the summit! This is a special stage only those with true determination can reach!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Now, unleash your passion! Shout out your dream with all your heart!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: My dream… I—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I want to become strong enough to compete against Air Groove and the rest of the Mejiro family!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Heh! You were so cool just now, even the world acknowledges you for who you are!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That wasn't half bad! I'll give you that much!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: A-all I could think about was putting one foot in front of the other…
choice_data_list: You look stronger than you did before the hike.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Q-quit making fun of me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Not you too, Trainer! Stop trying to embarrass me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Still, I guess that did help toughen me up…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Still, I guess that did help toughen me up…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later, possibly thanks to her special training, Mejiro Dober does well both on her exams and in her training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: The power to overcome my nerves…

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That tracks! I can't pull off any pranks if I'm too nervous 'bout things!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I have a plan! Now, then…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Let's scale a cliff!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Because there's no training more suited to conquering the hurdle known as anxiety!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Er… So you're saying that this cliff is my anxiety?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Precisely! I couldn't have asked for a more perfect and sophisticated answer! ♪ A new world awaits you beyond that wall!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I-I don't know about that…
choice_data_list: I'll climb it with you! I want to overcome this together!
I'll climb it with you! I want to overcome this together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Are you kidding me?! There's no reason for you to climb it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Don't be ridiculous! You might get hurt if you try!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Waiting is part of your job! Use that path over there to get to the top instead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Don't worry about me. Use that path and wait for me at the end… just like you always do for me at my races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Urgh! This is just as tough as I thought…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Urgh! This is just as tough as I thought…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The flowing breeze, the smell of the earth… Whew! I can feel the pulse of the world! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You're slowing down, girl! This can't be the extent of your willpower, can it?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Of course not!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (If I can climb this cliff, it'll prove how strong I've become, and I won't have to be scared of anything!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I… did it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Well… Yeah, I did.
choice_data_list: It looks like you had fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you… For some reason, it felt like I was in a race.
choice_data_list: It looks like you had fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: As if…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I guess…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Anyway, I do feel stronger now, so I suppose that wasn't a total waste of time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It was a reckless climb, but I'm feeling better now, and I think I'm stronger too…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪ Looks like you've broken through another one of your shells and made it to a new world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪ Looks like you've broken through another one of your shells and made it to a new world!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You should be grateful to us!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Haha… I had no idea what was going on the whole time… but this really did make me tougher.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you both. And… I guess you too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you both. And… Trainer, thank you to you too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later, possibly thanks to her special training, Mejiro Dober does well both on her exams and in her training.
